brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Poland is preparing to build a factory to produce Patriot missiles and a US base has been decided, while the country is racing ahead with military spending. [1][2][3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR POLAND
Poland's military buildup, including a Patriot missile factory and a US base, occurs despite a Country Instability Index score of 33 of 100, indicating the country remains in the Normal band. [1][2][E1]

KEY RISKS
Poland's net energy import dependency of 46% exposes it to supply disruptions and price volatility, which could be exacerbated by increased military spending. [E4]
Poland is linked to 13 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, creating potential compliance and reputational risks for its defense and energy sectors. [E3]

WATCH ITEMS
It remains to be seen whether Poland's rapid military spending will help or damage its economic growth story. [3]
